full_prompt_en: A square highly saturated still-life photograph is seen from directly overhead. A deep blue ceramic bowl sits left of center on a vivid cobalt surface that carries pale wavering light streaks. Inside the bowl, round citrus fruits fill most of the space: bright orange and red-orange forms, yellow fruit, a green fruit, and a sliced lime whose pale radial segments face upward. Small violet flowers cluster along the left interior edge, their petals touching the fruit and adding a cooler purple accent. The rim of the bowl is narrow and glossy, shifting from turquoise highlight to near-black shadow. Strong directional light from the upper left catches the pebbled fruit skins and the wet-looking shine of the lime cut, while a dense navy shadow falls toward the lower left outside the bowl. On the right side of the composition, a vertical strip of flat color swatches runs from magenta and orange through yellow, green, teal, blue, and violet. These blocks make the palette itself part of the image without adding words. The surrounding blue field remains uncluttered, yet faint pale caustic-like lines bend through it, suggesting reflected water light. Colors are clean, intense, and sharply separated; the fruit retains photographic texture rather than becoming abstract shapes. The circular bowl, stacked round fruit, and straight swatch strip balance curved organic forms against graphic order. Bright light and a dark cast shadow give this compact arrangement vivid depth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形高饱和静物照片从正上方俯视。深蓝陶瓷碗位于中央偏左，放在鲜艳钴蓝色表面上，表面有浅色摇曳光纹。碗里大部分空间被圆形柑橘填满：明亮橙色与红橙色果实、黄色果实、一颗绿色果实，以及切面朝上的青柠，其浅色放射状果瓣清楚可见。小簇紫罗兰色花朵沿碗内左缘聚集，花瓣碰着水果，加入偏冷的紫色点缀。碗沿细窄而发亮，从青绿高光过渡到近黑阴影。强烈的左上方定向光照亮带细孔的果皮和青柠切面湿润般的光泽，碗外浓重海军蓝阴影向左下投去。构图右侧，一条竖直平涂色样从洋红、橙、黄延至绿、青、蓝和紫。这些色块让调色本身成为图像的一部分，却没有加入文字。周围蓝色场地保持简净，淡淡浅色焦散般曲线从中弯过，暗示水面反射的光。颜色干净、强烈、界限清楚；水果保留摄影纹理，而不是变为抽象形体。圆碗、堆叠圆果和直线色样条让弯曲有机形与图形秩序相平衡。明亮光线和深色落影使紧凑陈列具有鲜明纵深。
style_prompt_en: Saturated color photography arranges clean blocks of cobalt, orange, yellow, green, violet, and magenta at nearly maximum intensity. A large single-color ground gives smaller contrasting forms exceptional clarity. Glossy highlights and hard directional cast shadows keep the bright palette dimensional rather than flat, while fine real-world surface texture survives within each colored area. Rounded clustered masses can be balanced by one straight graphic accent, creating order within abundance. The light is crisp, with pale reflective streaks and deep cool shadow sharing the same field. Edges stay sharply legible, and warm colors project strongly from a cool background. The overall effect is playful, deliberate, and visually immediate.
style_prompt_zh: 饱和色摄影把钴蓝、橙、黄、绿、紫罗兰和洋红以接近最高强度排列。大面积单一底色让较小对比形体极其清楚。光亮高光与硬朗定向落影使明艳调色保持体积而非平板，每个色域里仍保留细致真实表面纹理。圆润簇集体块可由一处笔直图形点缀平衡，在丰盛之中建立秩序。光清脆，浅色反光条纹与深冷阴影共处一片色场。边缘清楚可读，暖色从冷背景强烈向前突出。整体效果活泼、有意安排且直接抓住目光。
theme_en: Citrus fruit and violet flowers in a blue bowl on a vivid blue surface
theme_zh: 鲜蓝色表面上的蓝碗盛着柑橘与紫花
name: Saturated colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
